note: IPP head: with `txco dev --ipp` the tenant's `_ipp` stack makes it a printer at ipps://ipp.localhost:8443/p/<printer> once the IPP_PASSWORD secret is set. The probe cannot speak IPP or set a secret (HTTP checks only), so it covers what rides the web head: the listing route answers, and /p/<printer> on the ORDINARY hostname is the stack's own path — printers exist only on `ipp.<host>`. Printing itself is exercised by the Go tests (chassis/server/personality/ipp) and by hand with ipptool — see the README. Binds localhost → ipp-demo; `ipp.localhost` then resolves to this tenant through that binding.

checks.name: /p/<printer> on an ordinary hostname is the stack's path, not a printer
